build.source: Pristine git archive of the fork's imported revision

oracle: Independent Arrow/NumPy aggregates and Python SHA3 framing over every typed input value.

protocol.execution: sequential balanced rotation across isolated worker processes
protocol.query_timing: CREATE TEMP TABLE AS SELECT, including preparation and in-memory result materialization; validation excluded
protocol.point_timing: 100 prepared point reads, including shared Python/ctypes binding and result conversion
protocol.update_timing: 100 prepared random updates in one FULL-synchronous committed transaction; validation/restoration excluded
protocol.load_timing: single observation per arm: same native CSV reader, casts, INSERT SELECT and commit; preprocessing excluded
protocol.comparison: pristine revision-matched SQLite, same SQLite with declared workload indexes, SQLNEW columnar
limits: Warm local single-connection workload; not a cold-cache or concurrent-service benchmark.
Public workloads adapted to supported SQL and available machine scale; not published-suite scores.
Load and index-build times are single observations, not sampled estimates.
No composite winner score; workload tradeoffs reported separately.

datasets.description: H2O group cardinalities and value distributions; NumPy PCG64 seed 108, not R-identical rows; K=100, no NULLs, unsorted.
adaptations: 1,000,000-row default instead of the original minimum 10,000,000; configurable.
Portable SELECTs materialized into a temporary table; deterministic result ordering added.
q6 (median/stddev) and q9 (correlation) are reported unsupported by both SQLite configurations and SQLNEW.

datasets.description: Complete pinned GitHub taxi fixture: April 2021 NYC yellow taxi, all 18 columns and 2,171,187 rows in source order.
adaptations: Timestamps become integer Unix seconds; numeric and text values and NULLs retained; signed zero canonicalized.
Separate persistent load and warm query phases instead of the source's mixed CSV-import/end-to-end timings.
